format.example:
Chapter 1: Entering the Jianghu

format.line1Suffix: files are supported. It is recommended to use a separate chapter title line for each chapter.
format.line2Suffix: , then the main content begins on the next line.
format.line3: 3. The main text should be wrapped by paragraphs, and the first line can be indented by two characters.
format.line4: 4. Keep a blank line between chapters. Do not add extra dividers, "The End", export timestamps, or other distracting content.
